attachments.dropToAttach.description: Overlay shown across a message box while the person drags files over it: releasing them there attaches them to the message being written.

attachments.remove.description: Tooltip of the small × button on a file waiting to be sent in the message box: takes that file off the message.

attachments.removeNamed.description: Accessible name of the × button on a file waiting to be sent in the message box. {{file}} is the file's name.

attachments.removeUnnamed.description: Accessible name of the × button on a file waiting to be sent in the message box. Used for a file with no name; "file" is written as it has always been shown.

attachments.refusedMore_one.description: Error under the message box when several chosen files were refused. {{reason}} is a complete sentence saying why the first one was refused, kept first; {{count}} is how many other files were also left out.

attachments.refusedMore_other.description: Error under the message box when several chosen files were refused. {{reason}} is a complete sentence saying why the first one was refused, kept first; {{count}} is how many other files were also left out.

friends.error.requestFailed.description: Error shown when a friend action failed and the server gave no explanation. {{status}} is the HTTP status number.

friends.error.cannotAdd.text: You can’t add @{{username}} as a friend right now.
friends.error.cannotAdd.description: Error shown when a friend request could not be sent to this person. {{username}} is their username; keep the @ in front of it.

friends.error.cannotAddUnnamed.text: You can’t add @them as a friend right now.
friends.error.cannotAddUnnamed.description: Error shown when a friend request could not be sent and the person's username is not known. "@them" stands in for the username in English; write whatever reads naturally for an unnamed person, with or without the @.

friends.error.updateFailed.text: Couldn’t update this friendship. Check your connection and try again.
friends.error.updateFailed.description: Error shown when adding, accepting, declining or removing a friend failed, usually because the network is down.

friends.button.requested.description: Label of the friend button on a person's profile after you sent them a friend request that they have not answered yet. Pressing it opens a menu to cancel the request.

friends.button.requestedMenu.description: Accessible name of the friend button while your friend request to this person is unanswered: states that the request was sent and that pressing opens more options. {{username}} is their username; keep the @.

friends.button.cancelRequest.description: Menu item under the "Requested" friend button: withdraws the friend request you sent to this person.

friends.button.cancelRequestConfirm.description: Confirmation question before withdrawing a friend request you sent. {{username}} is the person it was sent to; keep the @.

friends.button.accept.description: Button beside a person who sent you a friend request: accepts it, making you friends.

friends.button.decline.description: Button beside a person who sent you a friend request: turns the request down.

friends.button.friends.description: Label of the friend button on the profile of a person you are already friends with. It is a state, not an action; pressing it opens a menu to unfriend.

friends.button.friendsMenu.description: Accessible name of the friend button for a person you are friends with: states the friendship and that pressing opens more options. {{username}} is their username; keep the @.

friends.button.unfriend.description: Menu item under the "Friends" button: ends your friendship with this person.

friends.button.unfriendConfirm.description: Confirmation question before ending a friendship. {{username}} is the friend; keep the @. The second sentence says the other person gets no notice.

friends.button.addFriend.description: Button on a person's profile or search result: sends them a friend request.

friends.search.failed.text: Search isn’t working right now. Check your connection and try again.
friends.search.failed.description: Note under the friend search box on your profile when the search request failed.

friends.search.searching.description: Note under the friend search box while results for the typed username are being fetched.

friends.search.noMatch.description: Note under the friend search box when no person's username matches. {{query}} is what the person typed.

friends.search.label.description: Placeholder and accessible label of the search box on your profile where you type a username to find people to add as friends.

imageViewer.imageName.description: Accessible name of the full-screen picture viewer and of the picture in it when the picture has no name of its own. A noun.

imageViewer.openOriginal.description: Link at the top of the full-screen picture viewer, for a picture hosted on another site: opens the original file in a new browser tab.

imageViewer.downloading.description: Label of the download button in the full-screen picture viewer while the picture is being saved.

imageViewer.tapToSave.description: Label of the download button in the full-screen picture viewer when the phone needs one more tap before it will open its save or share sheet.

imageViewer.download.description: Button at the top of the full-screen picture viewer: saves the picture to the device.

imageSave.saved_one.description: Brief confirmation after pictures from a message were saved to the phone. {{count}} is how many pictures. {{count}} is available in this form too, although English does not show it: a language whose singular form is also used for 21 or 101 should print the number.

imageSave.saved_other.description: Brief confirmation after pictures from a message were saved to the phone. {{count}} is how many pictures.

imageSave.failed.description: Brief error shown when saving a picture from a message to the device failed.

imageSave.updateApp.text: This version of the Homeroom app can’t save pictures. Update the app to save them.
imageSave.updateApp.description: Brief message shown when someone taps Download on a picture inside an older Homeroom mobile app that has no way to save pictures to the phone.

imageSave.menuDownload_one.description: Item in a message's actions menu: saves the pictures attached to that message to the device. {{count}} is how many pictures the message has. {{count}} is available in this form too, although English does not show it: a language whose singular form is also used for 21 or 101 should print the number.

imageSave.menuDownload_other.description: Item in a message's actions menu: saves the pictures attached to that message to the device. {{count}} is how many pictures the message has.

actions.toolbar.description: Accessible name of the small toolbar that appears on a message (react, reply, save, more), and of the same actions as a sheet on a phone.

actions.removeReaction.description: Accessible name of a quick-reaction button on a message you already reacted to with that emoji: pressing it takes your reaction back. {{emoji}} is the emoji's English name, for example "thumbs up".

actions.reactWith.description: Accessible name of a quick-reaction button on a message: adds that emoji as your reaction. {{emoji}} is the emoji's English name, for example "thumbs up".

actions.addReaction.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the smiley button on a message: opens the emoji picker to choose a reaction.

actions.reply.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the arrow button on a message: starts a reply to that message. A verb.

actions.unsaveMessage.description: Accessible name of the bookmark button on a message you saved: removes it from your saved items.

actions.saveMessage.description: Accessible name of the bookmark button on a message: keeps the message in your notifications so you can find it later.

actions.savedTooltip.description: Tooltip of the bookmark button on a message that is already saved.

actions.saveTooltip.description: Tooltip of the bookmark button on a message that is not saved yet. Saved messages are listed in the notifications panel.

actions.moreActions.description: Accessible name of the "…" button on a message and of the menu it opens (copy, edit, delete and so on).

actions.more.description: Tooltip of the "…" button on a message that opens the menu of further actions.

actions.sheet.close.description: Accessible name of the dimmed background behind the message actions sheet on a phone: tapping it closes the sheet.

actions.sheet.previewAttachment.description: Shown after the author's name at the top of the message actions sheet in place of the message's words, when the message is only a file or picture. A noun.

clipboard.copied.description: Brief confirmation shown after something from a message was copied to the clipboard.

clipboard.failed.text: Couldn’t copy. Your browser blocked the clipboard.
clipboard.failed.description: Brief error shown when copying a message's text or link to the clipboard failed.

emoji.category.smileys.description: Name of a section of the emoji picker: smiling and other faces.

emoji.category.people.description: Name of a section of the emoji picker: people and hand gestures.

emoji.category.hearts.description: Name of a section of the emoji picker: heart emoji.

emoji.category.nature.description: Name of a section of the emoji picker: animals, plants and weather.

emoji.category.food.description: Name of a section of the emoji picker: food and drinks.

emoji.category.activities.description: Name of a section of the emoji picker: sports, games and celebrations.

emoji.category.objects.description: Name of a section of the emoji picker: vehicles, places and everyday objects.

emoji.category.symbols.description: Name of a section of the emoji picker: signs, shapes, arrows and flags.

emoji.category.recent.description: Name of the first section of the emoji picker: the emoji this person reacted with most recently.

emoji.picker.name.description: Accessible name of the emoji picker that opens from a message.

emoji.picker.search.description: Placeholder and accessible label of the search box at the top of the emoji picker.

emoji.picker.categories.description: Accessible name of the row of icon tabs in the emoji picker that jump to each section.

emoji.picker.matching.description: Accessible name of the grid of search results in the emoji picker.

emoji.picker.noMatch.description: Shown in the emoji picker when the search finds nothing. {{query}} is what the person typed.

emoji.picker.hint.description: Hint in the footer of the emoji picker while no emoji is hovered or focused.

thread.activity.what_one.description: Heading of the card in a conversation that shows new replies made inside a thread under an older message. {{count}} is how many replies the card shows. {{count}} is available in this form too, although English does not show it: a language whose singular form is also used for 21 or 101 should print the number.

thread.activity.what_other.description: Heading of the card in a conversation that shows new replies made inside a thread under an older message. {{count}} is how many replies the card shows.

thread.activity.rootDeleted.description: Shown on the thread-replies card in place of the thread's first message when that message was deleted.

thread.activity.rootNoText.description: Shown alone, in its own muted element beside the heading "Replied in thread", on the card of replies made in a thread: stands in for the thread's first message when that message has no words (for example only a picture). It is not joined to the heading in code; it is lower case in English because nothing is capitalized there.

thread.activity.open_one.description: Accessible name of the thread-replies card: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies, {{message}} is the text of the thread's first message and {{time}} is the time of the latest reply. {{count}} is available in this form too, although English does not show it: a language whose singular form is also used for 21 or 101 should print the number.

thread.activity.open_other.description: Accessible name of the thread-replies card: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies, {{message}} is the text of the thread's first message and {{time}} is the time of the latest reply.

thread.activity.openDeleted_one.text: Replied in thread: Message deleted, {{time}}. Open thread
thread.activity.openDeleted_one.description: Accessible name of the thread-replies card when the thread's first message was deleted: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies and {{time}} is the time of the latest reply. {{count}} is available in this form too, although English does not show it: a language whose singular form is also used for 21 or 101 should print the number.

thread.activity.openDeleted_other.text: {{count}} replies in thread: Message deleted, {{time}}. Open thread
thread.activity.openDeleted_other.description: Accessible name of the thread-replies card when the thread's first message was deleted: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies and {{time}} is the time of the latest reply.

thread.activity.openNoText_one.text: Replied in thread: a message, {{time}}. Open thread
thread.activity.openNoText_one.description: Accessible name of the thread-replies card when the thread's first message has no words: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies and {{time}} is the time of the latest reply. {{count}} is available in this form too, although English does not show it: a language whose singular form is also used for 21 or 101 should print the number.

thread.activity.openNoText_other.text: {{count}} replies in thread: a message, {{time}}. Open thread
thread.activity.openNoText_other.description: Accessible name of the thread-replies card when the thread's first message has no words: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies and {{time}} is the time of the latest reply.

thread.activity.attachment.description: Shown on the thread-replies card in place of a reply's words when the reply is only a file or picture. A noun.

thread.summary.count_one.description: Label on the chip under a message that has a thread: how many replies the thread holds. {{count}} is that number.

thread.summary.count_other.description: Label on the chip under a message that has a thread: how many replies the thread holds. {{count}} is that number.

thread.summary.openLastFromAt_one.description: Accessible name of the thread chip under a message: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies, {{username}} wrote the latest one (keep the @) and {{when}} is how long ago, for example "5m ago".

thread.summary.openLastFromAt_other.description: Accessible name of the thread chip under a message: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies, {{username}} wrote the latest one (keep the @) and {{when}} is how long ago, for example "5m ago".

thread.summary.openLastFromUnknownAt_one.description: Accessible name of the thread chip under a message: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies, Used on the Messages screen when the username of the person who replied last is not known; "@unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

thread.summary.openLastFromUnknownAt_oth.description: Accessible name of the thread chip under a message: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies, Used on the Messages screen when the username of the person who replied last is not known; "@unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

thread.summary.openLastFromSomeoneAt_one.description: Accessible name of the thread chip under a message: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies, Used in an app's chat when nobody can be named for the last reply; "@someone" is written as it has always been shown.

thread.summary.openLastFromSomeoneAt_oth.description: Accessible name of the thread chip under a message: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies, Used in an app's chat when nobody can be named for the last reply; "@someone" is written as it has always been shown.

thread.summary.openLastFrom_one.description: Accessible name of the thread chip under a message when the time of the latest reply is unknown: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies and {{username}} wrote the latest one (keep the @).

thread.summary.openLastFrom_other.description: Accessible name of the thread chip under a message when the time of the latest reply is unknown: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies and {{username}} wrote the latest one (keep the @).

thread.summary.openLastFromUnknown_one.description: Accessible name of the thread chip under a message when the time of the latest reply is unknown: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies and Used on the Messages screen when the username of the person who replied last is not known; "@unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

thread.summary.openLastFromUnknown_other.description: Accessible name of the thread chip under a message when the time of the latest reply is unknown: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies and Used on the Messages screen when the username of the person who replied last is not known; "@unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

thread.summary.openLastFromSomeone_one.description: Accessible name of the thread chip under a message when the time of the latest reply is unknown: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies and Used in an app's chat when nobody can be named for the last reply; "@someone" is written as it has always been shown.

thread.summary.openLastFromSomeone_other.description: Accessible name of the thread chip under a message when the time of the latest reply is unknown: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies and Used in an app's chat when nobody can be named for the last reply; "@someone" is written as it has always been shown.

thread.summary.openLastAt_one.description: Accessible name of the compact thread chip under a message: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies and {{when}} is how long ago the latest one was written, for example "5m ago".

thread.summary.openLastAt_other.description: Accessible name of the compact thread chip under a message: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies and {{when}} is how long ago the latest one was written, for example "5m ago".

thread.summary.open_one.description: Accessible name of the compact thread chip under a message when the time of the latest reply is unknown: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies.

thread.summary.open_other.description: Accessible name of the compact thread chip under a message when the time of the latest reply is unknown: pressing it opens the thread. {{count}} is the number of replies.

thread.summary.attachment.description: Shown on the thread chip in place of the latest reply's words when that reply is only a file or picture. A noun.

thread.summary.lastReply.description: Shown on the compact thread chip under a message. {{when}} is how long ago the latest reply was written, for example "5m ago".

list.dot.description: Joins two short independent facts on one status line, for example "Building · 5m so far". {{first}} and {{second}} are each already a complete translated phrase. Use the separator your language uses between such facts.

approval.list.comma.description: Joins people in a list of who has yet to approve a change, before the final "and" or "or". {{first}} is the list so far and {{second}} is the next person. The items are account names (@ada), and sometimes the reader or a count of unnamed people, which have entries of their own for each place a list can stand.

approval.list.and.description: Ends a list of the people who all have yet to approve a change, as in "you, @ada and @cy". {{first}} is everyone before the last item and {{last}} is the last item. The items are account names (@ada), and sometimes the reader or a count of unnamed people, which have entries of their own for each place a list can stand.

approval.list.or.description: Ends a list of people any one of whom could give a missing approval, as in "@ada, @ben or 2 others". {{first}} is everyone before the last item and {{last}} is the last item. The items are account names (@ada), and sometimes the reader or a count of unnamed people, which have entries of their own for each place a list can stand.

approval.list.from.you.description: An item in a list of the people whose approval a change is waiting for: the reader themselves. The list follows "from" in a sentence such as "Waiting for approval from you, @ada and 2 more" or "Needs 2 approvals from @ada, @ben or 2 others"; use the form your language needs in that position. When the reader is the only one, a whole sentence is used instead ("Waiting for approval from you").

approval.list.from.more_one.description: Last item in a list of people who all have yet to approve a change: how many further people are not named. {{count}} is that number. The list follows "from" in a sentence such as "Waiting for approval from you, @ada and 2 more" or "Needs 2 approvals from @ada, @ben or 2 others"; use the form your language needs in that position.

approval.list.from.more_other.description: Last item in a list of people who all have yet to approve a change: how many further people are not named. {{count}} is that number. The list follows "from" in a sentence such as "Waiting for approval from you, @ada and 2 more" or "Needs 2 approvals from @ada, @ben or 2 others"; use the form your language needs in that position.

approval.list.from.others_one.description: Last item in a list of people any one of whom could approve a change: how many further people are not named. {{count}} is that number. The list follows "from" in a sentence such as "Waiting for approval from you, @ada and 2 more" or "Needs 2 approvals from @ada, @ben or 2 others"; use the form your language needs in that position.

approval.list.from.others_other.description: Last item in a list of people any one of whom could approve a change: how many further people are not named. {{count}} is that number. The list follows "from" in a sentence such as "Waiting for approval from you, @ada and 2 more" or "Needs 2 approvals from @ada, @ben or 2 others"; use the form your language needs in that position.

approval.list.subject.more_one.description: Last item in a list of people who all have yet to approve a change: how many further people are not named. {{count}} is that number. The list is the subject of a sentence such as "It goes live when @ada, @cy and 2 more approve too."; use the form your language needs for a subject.

approval.list.subject.more_other.description: Last item in a list of people who all have yet to approve a change: how many further people are not named. {{count}} is that number. The list is the subject of a sentence such as "It goes live when @ada, @cy and 2 more approve too."; use the form your language needs for a subject.

approval.needs_one.description: Status line on a change that is ready: how many approvals it still needs and who can give them. {{count}} is the number of approvals; {{people}} is a list of people joined with "or", such as "@ada or @ben". {{count}} is available in this form too, although English does not show it: a language whose singular form is also used for 21 or 101 should print the number.

approval.needs_other.description: Status line on a change that is ready: how many approvals it still needs and who can give them. {{count}} is the number of approvals; {{people}} is a list of people joined with "or", such as "@ada or @ben".

approval.needsMore_one.description: Status line on a change that already has some approvals: how many more it needs and who can give them. {{count}} is the number still missing; {{people}} is a list of people joined with "or". {{count}} is available in this form too, although English does not show it: a language whose singular form is also used for 21 or 101 should print the number.

approval.needsMore_other.description: Status line on a change that already has some approvals: how many more it needs and who can give them. {{count}} is the number still missing; {{people}} is a list of people joined with "or".

approval.waiting.description: Status line on a change that is ready, when every listed person must approve. {{people}} is a list joined with "and": account names such as @ada, possibly the reader ("you") first and a count of unnamed people last, each already in the form that follows "from". When the reader is the only one, "Waiting for approval from you" is used instead.

approval.waitingYou.description: Status line on a change that is ready, when the reader's own approval is the only one it is waiting for. No full stop.

bot.job.firstVersion.description: Name of a piece of work Homeroom bot is doing: building the first version of a project. {{project}} is the project's name.

bot.job.firstVersionUnnamed.description: Name of a piece of work Homeroom bot is doing: building the first version of a project. Used when the project cannot be named; "A project" is written as the line has always shown it.

bot.job.request.description: Name of a piece of work Homeroom bot is doing: a numbered request in a project. {{project}} is the project's name and {{number}} is the request number; keep the # before the number.

bot.job.requestUnnamed.description: Name of a piece of work Homeroom bot is doing: a numbered request in a project. Used when the project cannot be named; "A project" is written as the line has always shown it. {{number}} is the request's number; keep the #.

bot.job.requestTitled.description: Full name of a piece of work Homeroom bot is doing. {{project}} is the project's name, {{number}} the request number (keep the #) and {{title}} the request's title as its author wrote it.

bot.job.requestTitledUnnamed.description: Full name of a piece of work Homeroom bot is doing. Used when the project cannot be named; "A project" is written as the line has always shown it. {{number}} is the request's number and {{title}} its title.

bot.job.titled.description: Full name of a piece of work Homeroom bot is doing when the request has no number. {{project}} is the project's name and {{title}} the request's title as its author wrote it.

bot.job.titledUnnamed.description: Full name of a piece of work Homeroom bot is doing when the request has no number. Used when the project cannot be named; "A project" is written as the line has always shown it. {{title}} is the title of the work.

bot.job.unnamedProject.description: Stands in for a project's name on a Homeroom bot activity card when the name is not known.

bot.outcome.question.description: How a piece of Homeroom bot's work ended, shown as the status on its activity card and in its history: the bot asked the person a question and is waiting for the answer. Homeroom bot is the assistant that builds changes; "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.outcome.proposed.description: How a piece of Homeroom bot's work ended, shown as the status on its activity card and in its history: the change is built and waits for the group's approval. Homeroom bot is the assistant that builds changes; "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.outcome.live.description: How a piece of Homeroom bot's work ended, shown as the status on its activity card and in its history: the change is built and now in use. Homeroom bot is the assistant that builds changes; "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.outcome.closed.text: Built it. The change was closed
bot.outcome.closed.description: How a piece of Homeroom bot's work ended, shown as the status on its activity card and in its history: the change was built but then closed without going into use. Homeroom bot is the assistant that builds changes; "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.outcome.blocked.text: Can’t build it as it’s written
bot.outcome.blocked.description: How a piece of Homeroom bot's work ended, shown as the status on its activity card and in its history: the request cannot be built as it is worded. Homeroom bot is the assistant that builds changes; "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.outcome.buildFailed.description: How a piece of Homeroom bot's work ended, shown as the status on its activity card and in its history: the build did not complete. Homeroom bot is the assistant that builds changes; "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.outcome.person.text: Left it for the group to decide
bot.outcome.person.description: How a piece of Homeroom bot's work ended, shown as the status on its activity card and in its history: the bot left the decision to the group. Homeroom bot is the assistant that builds changes; "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.outcome.empty.description: How a piece of Homeroom bot's work ended, shown as the status on its activity card and in its history: the bot found nothing in the request to build. Homeroom bot is the assistant that builds changes; "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.outcome.failed.description: How a piece of Homeroom bot's work ended, shown as the status on its activity card and in its history: the bot could not finish reading the request. Homeroom bot is the assistant that builds changes; "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.outcome.held.text: Ready, but held back for now
bot.outcome.held.description: How a piece of Homeroom bot's work ended, shown as the status on its activity card and in its history: the change is ready but is being kept back for the moment. Homeroom bot is the assistant that builds changes; "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.outcome.stopped.description: How a piece of Homeroom bot's work ended, shown as the status on its activity card and in its history: the work was stopped before it finished. Homeroom bot is the assistant that builds changes; "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.outcome.answer.description: How a piece of Homeroom bot's work ended, shown as the status on its activity card and in its history: the bot answered a question on the change. Homeroom bot is the assistant that builds changes; "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.outcome.revise.description: How a piece of Homeroom bot's work ended, shown as the status on its activity card and in its history: the bot updated the change after feedback. Homeroom bot is the assistant that builds changes; "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.outcome.checking.text: Built it. Checking it before you try it
bot.outcome.checking.description: How a piece of Homeroom bot's work ended, shown as the status on its activity card and in its history: the change is built and is being checked before the person can try it. Homeroom bot is the assistant that builds changes; "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.outcome.needsLook.text: Built it, but it needs a look
bot.outcome.needsLook.description: How a piece of Homeroom bot's work ended, shown as the status on its activity card and in its history: the change is built but something in it needs the person's attention. Homeroom bot is the assistant that builds changes; "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.outcome.goingLive.description: How a piece of Homeroom bot's work ended, shown as the status on its activity card and in its history: the change is built, approved and being put into use, when there is no release estimate to say instead. Homeroom bot is the assistant that builds changes; "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.tone.done.description: Small heading on a Homeroom bot activity card: the work finished and nothing more is needed.

bot.tone.built.description: Small heading on a Homeroom bot activity card: the change has been built (past participle) and is waiting for a next step such as approval.

bot.tone.you.description: Small heading on a Homeroom bot activity card: the bot is waiting for the reader to answer or decide something.

bot.tone.ended.description: Small heading on a Homeroom bot activity card: the work ended without a change going into use.

bot.tone.trouble.description: Small heading on a Homeroom bot activity card: the work failed or was stopped before finishing.

bot.span.underMinute.description: A duration of less than one minute, shown where a length of time is given on a Homeroom bot card, as in "under a minute so far" or "took under a minute".

bot.span.minutes.description: A short duration in minutes on a Homeroom bot card. {{minutes}} is a number; "m" abbreviates minutes.

bot.span.hours.description: A short duration in whole hours on a Homeroom bot card. {{hours}} is a number; "h" abbreviates hours.

bot.tray.earlierRuns_other.description: Button on a tile in Homeroom bot's Activity panel: shows or hides the bot's earlier attempts at the same request. A "run" is one attempt by the bot; {{count}} is how many.

bot.tray.eyebrowStep.description: Small heading on a tile in Homeroom bot's Activity panel for work in progress. {{step}} is the current step number and {{total}} the number of steps.

bot.tray.eyebrowStepNamed.description: Small heading on a tile in Homeroom bot's Activity panel for work in progress. {{step}} is the current step number, {{total}} the number of steps and {{name}} what the step is called.

bot.tray.eyebrowWorking.description: Small heading on a tile in Homeroom bot's Activity panel for work in progress when no step number is known. "it" is the request.

bot.tray.soFar.description: One fact in the dot-separated status of a tile in Homeroom bot's Activity panel, complete on its own: how long the bot has been working on it. {{duration}} is a short duration such as "5m", "2h 5m" or "under a minute".

bot.tray.waitingOnYou.description: Status of a tile in Homeroom bot's Activity panel when the bot waits for the person and has said nothing more specific.

bot.tray.panelName.description: Accessible name of the panel that lists what Homeroom bot is working on. Homeroom bot is the assistant's name.

bot.tray.loadFailed.text: Couldn’t load what I’m working on.
bot.tray.loadFailed.description: Error in Homeroom bot's Activity panel when the list could not be fetched. The bot speaks in the first person. A "Try again" button follows.

bot.tray.loading.description: Accessible label of the placeholder shown while Homeroom bot's Activity panel loads.

bot.tray.sectionNow.description: Section heading in Homeroom bot's Activity panel: the work the bot is doing at this moment.

bot.tray.sectionNeedsYou.description: Section heading in Homeroom bot's Activity panel: requests that wait for the reader to answer or decide.

bot.tray.idle.text: I’m not working on anything for you right now.
bot.tray.idle.description: Note in Homeroom bot's Activity panel when nothing is in progress and nothing waits for the person. The bot speaks in the first person.

bot.tray.hideHistory.description: Button in Homeroom bot's Activity panel: folds away the list of finished work.

bot.tray.showHistory_one.description: Button in Homeroom bot's Activity panel: unfolds the list of finished work. {{count}} is how many finished items there are.

bot.tray.showHistory_other.description: Button in Homeroom bot's Activity panel: unfolds the list of finished work. {{count}} is how many finished items there are.

bot.tray.empty.text: Nothing yet. When I work on a request of yours, it shows up here.
bot.tray.empty.description: Note in Homeroom bot's Activity panel when the bot has never worked on anything for this person. The bot speaks in the first person.

bot.tray.stale.text: Couldn’t refresh this just now; it may be out of date.
bot.tray.stale.description: Note at the foot of Homeroom bot's Activity panel when the latest refresh failed and older information is still shown.

bot.head.requestNumber.description: Title of the card for a request in a message from Homeroom bot when the request's own title is not known. "Request" is a noun; {{number}} is the request number, keep the #.

bot.head.firstVersion.description: Subtitle of the project card in a message from Homeroom bot about building a project's first version.

bot.head.notFiled.description: Subtitle of the card for a request Homeroom bot offers to file but has not filed yet. {{project}} is the project's name.

bot.ready.title.project.description: Title of the card Homeroom bot sends when a project's first version is built and can be tried. {{project}} is the project's name.

bot.ready.title.projectBroken.text: {{project}} is built, but not everything works yet

bot.ready.title.unnamed.text: Your project is ready to try

bot.ready.title.unnamedBroken.text: Your project is built, but not everything works yet

bot.ready.title.change.text: Your change to {{project}} is ready to try
bot.ready.title.change.description: Title of the card Homeroom bot sends when the change the person asked for is built and can be tried. {{project}} is the project's name.

bot.ready.title.changeBroken.text: Your change to {{project}} is built, but not everything works yet

bot.ready.broken_other.description: Red line on Homeroom bot's "ready to try" card listing what in the built change does not work yet. {{count}} is how many things; {{problems}} is the descriptions of them joined with semicolons.

bot.ready.goingLive.description: Tooltip of the spinning ring on Homeroom bot's card while an approved change is being put into use.

bot.ready.youAsked.description: Line on Homeroom bot's "ready to try" card. {{request}} is what the person asked the bot for, in their own words.

bot.ready.choices.description: Accessible name of the group of buttons on Homeroom bot's "ready to try" card (try it, approve it, ask for changes).

bot.ready.line.live.description: Line on Homeroom bot's card for a change once the change is in use by everyone.

bot.plan.progress.doingAbout_one.description: Progress line under the title of Homeroom bot's plan card while it builds, a single line of facts separated by middle dots: what the bot says it is doing ({{doing}}, the bot's own words, already capitalized), then how long building usually takes: {{count}} is a number of minutes. "min" abbreviates minutes.

bot.plan.progress.doingAbout_other.description: Progress line under the title of Homeroom bot's plan card while it builds, a single line of facts separated by middle dots: what the bot says it is doing ({{doing}}, the bot's own words, already capitalized), then how long building usually takes: {{count}} is a number of minutes. "min" abbreviates minutes.

bot.plan.progress.doingRange_one.description: Progress line under the title of Homeroom bot's plan card while it builds, a single line of facts separated by middle dots: what the bot says it is doing ({{doing}}, the bot's own words, already capitalized), then the usual range of time building takes: {{from}} is the shorter number of minutes and {{count}} the longer. "min" abbreviates minutes.

bot.plan.progress.doingRange_other.description: Progress line under the title of Homeroom bot's plan card while it builds, a single line of facts separated by middle dots: what the bot says it is doing ({{doing}}, the bot's own words, already capitalized), then the usual range of time building takes: {{from}} is the shorter number of minutes and {{count}} the longer. "min" abbreviates minutes.

bot.plan.title.description: Title of the plan card Homeroom bot sends in Messages before it builds a project's first version. The bot speaks in the first person. {{project}} is the project's name.

bot.plan.titleUnnamed.description: Title of the plan card Homeroom bot sends in Messages before it builds a project's first version, when the project's name is not known. The bot speaks in the first person.

bot.plan.titleInApp.description: Title of Homeroom bot's plan card when it is shown on the project's own page; the plan's lines follow, so keep the colon. {{project}} is the project's name.

bot.plan.titleInAppUnnamed.text: Here’s my plan for your project:
bot.plan.titleInAppUnnamed.description: Title of Homeroom bot's plan card when it is shown on the project's own page and the project's name is not known; the plan's lines follow, so keep the colon.

bot.plan.name.description: Accessible name of Homeroom bot's plan card. "Plan" is a noun. {{project}} is the project's name.

bot.plan.nameUnnamed.description: Accessible name of Homeroom bot's plan card when the project's name is not known. "Plan" is a noun.

bot.plan.replaced.description: Line on an older plan card from Homeroom bot once the bot has sent a newer plan for the same project.

bot.plan.build.description: Main button on Homeroom bot's plan card: tells the bot to build what the plan describes. "Build" is a verb.

bot.plan.change.description: Secondary button on Homeroom bot's plan card: lets the person write what to change in the plan. "Change" is a verb.

bot.plan.building.description: Tooltip of the small spinning ring beside "Building it" on Homeroom bot's plan card.

bot.plan.state.built.description: Line on Homeroom bot's plan card after the person pressed "Build it": the bot is building what the plan describes.

bot.plan.state.stopped.text: I stopped waiting on this plan. Reply to pick it up again.
bot.plan.state.stopped.description: Line on Homeroom bot's plan card when nobody answered it for a week. The bot speaks in the first person; replying in the conversation revives the plan.

bot.plan.state.changing.text: You asked for changes. A new plan is on its way.
bot.plan.state.changing.description: Line on Homeroom bot's plan card after the person asked for something to be changed in it.

bot.plan.state.closed.description: Line on Homeroom bot's plan card once the plan no longer applies.

bot.questions.suggested.description: Small tag beside the first answer to one of Homeroom bot's questions: the answer the bot recommends. Lower case.

bot.questions.actions.description: Accessible name of the pair of buttons under Homeroom bot's two questions (Build it, Something else). A noun.

bot.questions.build.description: Button under Homeroom bot's questions about a request: sends the chosen answers and tells the bot to build. "Build" is a verb.

bot.questions.somethingElse.description: Button under Homeroom bot's questions: lets the person type their own answer instead of choosing one.

bot.questions.youAnswered.description: Shown under Homeroom bot's questions after the person answered. {{answers}} is their answers, one per line; keep the line break after the colon.

bot.questions.closed.description: Line under Homeroom bot's questions once they no longer apply.

bot.question.fileRequest.description: Accessible name of the buttons under Homeroom bot's offer to file a request on the person's behalf, when the bot gave no question of its own. "File" is a verb: to submit the request.

bot.question.suggestedAnswers.description: Accessible name of the group of answer buttons under a question from Homeroom bot.

bot.question.suggested.description: Small tag beside the first answer button under a question from Homeroom bot: the answer the bot recommends. Lower case.

bot.question.somethingElse.description: Button under a question from Homeroom bot: lets the person type their own answer instead of choosing one.

bot.question.youChose.description: Shown under Homeroom bot's offer after the person pressed one of its buttons. {{answer}} is the label of the button they pressed.

bot.question.youAnswered.description: Small label above the answer the person gave to a question from Homeroom bot.

bot.question.closed.description: Line under a question from Homeroom bot once it no longer applies.

bot.actions.questionsYouCanAsk.description: Accessible name of the group of buttons under a message from Homeroom bot when each button is a question the person can ask it.

bot.actions.whatNext.description: Accessible name of the group of buttons under a message from Homeroom bot when they are suggestions for a next step.

bot.actions.choices.description: Accessible name of the group of buttons under a message from Homeroom bot when they are choices to pick from.

bot.actions.youAsked.description: Shown under a message from Homeroom bot after the person pressed one of its suggested questions. {{question}} is the question they pressed.

bot.actions.youChose.description: Shown under a message from Homeroom bot after the person pressed one of its buttons. {{choice}} is the label of the button they pressed.

bot.actions.closed.description: Line under a message from Homeroom bot whose buttons no longer apply.

bot.posted.answer.firstVersion.text: Your answer is posted on {{project}}’s first-version request’s public discussion, where the group can see it.
bot.posted.answer.firstVersion.description: Note under a question from Homeroom bot, before and after the person answers: their answer is copied to the public discussion of the request it is about. The request is the one for the project's first version; {{project}} is the project's name.

bot.posted.answer.firstVersionUnnamed.text: Your answer is posted on the project’s first-version request’s public discussion, where the group can see it.
bot.posted.answer.firstVersionUnnamed.description: Note under a question from Homeroom bot, before and after the person answers: their answer is copied to the public discussion of the request it is about. The request is the one for the project's first version; the project's name is not known.

bot.posted.answer.request.text: Your answer is posted on {{project}} request #{{number}}’s public discussion, where the group can see it.
bot.posted.answer.request.description: Note under a question from Homeroom bot, before and after the person answers: their answer is copied to the public discussion of the request it is about. {{project}} is the project's name and {{number}} the request number; keep the #.

bot.posted.answer.requestUnnamed.text: Your answer is posted on the project request #{{number}}’s public discussion, where the group can see it.
bot.posted.answer.requestUnnamed.description: Note under a question from Homeroom bot, before and after the person answers: their answer is copied to the public discussion of the request it is about. The project's name is not known; {{number}} is the request number, keep the #.

bot.posted.answers.firstVersion.text: Your answers are posted on {{project}}’s first-version request’s public discussion, where the group can see them.
bot.posted.answers.firstVersion.description: Note under Homeroom bot's two questions: the person's answers are copied to the public discussion of the request they are about. The request is the one for the project's first version; {{project}} is the project's name.

bot.posted.answers.firstVersionUnnamed.text: Your answers are posted on the project’s first-version request’s public discussion, where the group can see them.
bot.posted.answers.firstVersionUnnamed.description: Note under Homeroom bot's two questions: the person's answers are copied to the public discussion of the request they are about. The request is the one for the project's first version; the project's name is not known.

bot.posted.answers.request.text: Your answers are posted on {{project}} request #{{number}}’s public discussion, where the group can see them.
bot.posted.answers.request.description: Note under Homeroom bot's two questions: the person's answers are copied to the public discussion of the request they are about. {{project}} is the project's name and {{number}} the request number; keep the #.

bot.posted.answers.requestUnnamed.text: Your answers are posted on the project request #{{number}}’s public discussion, where the group can see them.
bot.posted.answers.requestUnnamed.description: Note under Homeroom bot's two questions: the person's answers are copied to the public discussion of the request they are about. The project's name is not known; {{number}} is the request number, keep the #.

bot.posted.reply.firstVersion.text: Your reply is posted on {{project}}’s first-version request’s public discussion.
bot.posted.reply.firstVersion.description: Note in the message box while replying to a message from Homeroom bot about a request: the reply is copied to that request's public discussion. The request is the one for the project's first version; {{project}} is the project's name.

bot.posted.reply.firstVersionUnnamed.text: Your reply is posted on the project’s first-version request’s public discussion.
bot.posted.reply.firstVersionUnnamed.description: Note in the message box while replying to a message from Homeroom bot about a request: the reply is copied to that request's public discussion. The request is the one for the project's first version; the project's name is not known.

bot.posted.reply.request.text: Your reply is posted on {{project}} request #{{number}}’s public discussion.
bot.posted.reply.request.description: Note in the message box while replying to a message from Homeroom bot about a request: the reply is copied to that request's public discussion. {{project}} is the project's name and {{number}} the request number; keep the #.

bot.posted.reply.requestUnnamed.text: Your reply is posted on the project request #{{number}}’s public discussion.
bot.posted.reply.requestUnnamed.description: Note in the message box while replying to a message from Homeroom bot about a request: the reply is copied to that request's public discussion. The project's name is not known; {{number}} is the request number, keep the #.

bot.thanks.usually.description: Note beside "Building" on the card Homeroom bot sends after the person approved its plan: the usual range of time a build takes. {{from}} and {{to}} are numbers of minutes; "min" abbreviates minutes.

bot.thanks.unnamedProject.description: Stands in for the project's name on the card Homeroom bot sends after the person approved its plan, when the name is not known.

bot.notify.offer.description: Button under Homeroom bot's plan while it builds: asks for a phone notification when the build is ready to try.

bot.notify.done.description: Shown in place of the "Notify me when it’s ready" button once notifications are allowed. The bot speaks in the first person.

bot.notify.off.description: Shown in place of the "Notify me when it’s ready" button when the phone refused notifications for Homeroom.

bot.notify.groupName.description: Accessible name of the group holding the "Notify me when it’s ready" button under Homeroom bot's plan.

bot.notify.turnOn.description: Button shown when notifications are off for Homeroom on this phone: opens the phone's notification settings.

composer.attachLimit_one.text: You can attach up to {{count}} file.
composer.attachLimit_one.description: Error under the message box when more files were chosen than one message can carry. {{count}} is the most files a message can have.

composer.attachLimit_other.text: You can attach up to {{count}} files.
composer.attachLimit_other.description: Error under the message box when more files were chosen than one message can carry. {{count}} is the most files a message can have.

composer.fileTooLarge.text: {{file}} is too large for this file type.
composer.fileTooLarge.description: Error under the message box when a chosen file is over the size allowed for its kind. {{file}} is the file's name.

composer.uploadFailed.description: Error under the message box when attaching a file failed and the server gave no reason. {{file}} is the file's name.

composer.sendFailed.description: Error under the message box when sending failed and the server gave no reason.

composer.requestSent.title.description: Heading shown in place of the message box after your first message to someone who has not accepted a conversation with you yet. A "message request" is that first message, which they must accept.

composer.requestSent.waitingNamed.text: Waiting for {{username}} to accept your message request. You can send more once they do.
composer.requestSent.waitingNamed.description: Notice in place of the message box of a direct message whose first message was sent as a message request. {{username}} is the other person's username, written bare as a direct message names people (#4655).

composer.requestSent.waitingUnknown.text: Waiting for unknown to accept your message request. You can send more once they do.
composer.requestSent.waitingUnknown.description: Notice in place of the message box of a direct message whose first message was sent as a message request, when the other person's username did not come with the conversation. "unknown" stands where the username would be, written bare as a direct message names people.

composer.requestSent.waitingUnnamed.text: Waiting for them to accept your message request. You can send more once they do.
composer.requestSent.waitingUnnamed.description: Text under "Message request sent", in place of the message box, when the other person's username is not known.

composer.cannotSend.text: You can’t send messages in this conversation.
composer.cannotSend.description: Shown in place of the message box in a conversation the person may read but not write in.

composer.firstMessageHintNamed.text: {{username}} gets your first message as a message request. You can send more once they accept.
composer.firstMessageHintNamed.description: Line above the message box of a new direct message to someone who has not accepted you yet. {{username}} is their username, written bare as a direct message names people (#4655).

composer.firstMessageHintUnknown.text: unknown gets your first message as a message request. You can send more once they accept.
composer.firstMessageHintUnknown.description: Line above the message box of a new direct message when the other person's username did not come with the conversation. "unknown" stands where the username would be, written bare as a direct message names people.

composer.firstMessageHintUnnamed.text: They get your first message as a message request. You can send more once they accept.
composer.firstMessageHintUnnamed.description: Hint above the message box before your first message to someone who has not talked with you before, when their username is not known.

composer.replyingTo.description: Bar above the message box while writing a reply to one message. {{name}} is the author of that message, as shown in the conversation (for a person, their username with @).

composer.replyingToUnknownHandle.description: Bar above the message box while writing a reply to one message. Used when the username is not known; "@unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

composer.replyingToUnknown.description: Bar above the message box while writing a reply to one message. Used when the username is not known and the account has no id; "unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

composer.replyAttachment.description: Shown in the reply bar above the message box in place of the quoted message's words when that message is only a file or picture. A noun.

composer.planReplyNote.text: Say what to change, and Homeroom bot sends a new plan. Only you see this.
composer.planReplyNote.description: Note in the reply bar while replying to a plan from Homeroom bot. Homeroom bot is the assistant's name. "Change" is a verb.

composer.cancelReply.description: Accessible name of the × button on the reply bar above the message box: stops replying to that message and keeps the text typed.

composer.removeSharedItem.description: Accessible name of the × button on an item (an app, a request, a change) staged in the message box to be shared with the message.

composer.removeAttachment.description: Accessible name of the × button on a file attached to the message being written. {{file}} is the file's name.

composer.uploading_one.description: Shown beside the attached files in the message box while files upload. {{count}} is how many are still uploading.

composer.uploading_other.description: Shown beside the attached files in the message box while files upload. {{count}} is how many are still uploading.

composer.channelsMenu.description: Accessible name of the list of channels suggested while typing # in the message box.

composer.peopleMenu.description: Accessible name of the list of people suggested while typing @ in the message box.

composer.emojiMatching.description: Heading of the list of emoji suggested while typing a shortcode such as ":smile" in the message box. {{query}} is what was typed after the colon; keep the colon before it. The tags style the typed text.

composer.emojiMenu.description: Accessible name of the list of emoji suggested while typing a shortcode in the message box.

composer.addToMessage.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the + button beside the message box, and name of the menu it opens (attach files, share an item).

composer.attachFiles.description: Item in the + menu beside the message box: opens the file chooser to attach files to the message.

composer.shareItem.description: Item in the + menu beside the message box: opens a dialog to pick an app, request or change from Homeroom to send with the message. "Share" is a verb.

composer.placeholderThread.description: Placeholder in the message box of a thread.

composer.placeholder.description: Placeholder in the message box of a conversation. A noun: write a message here.

composer.labelThread.description: Accessible label of the message box of a thread.

composer.label.description: Accessible label of the message box of a conversation. A noun.

composer.send.description: Accessible name of the arrow button beside the message box: sends the message.

object.kind.app.description: Small label on a card for something shared in a message, and on the item waiting in the message box: the item is an app.

object.kind.issue.description: Small label on a card for something shared in a message: the item is a request, a filed ask for a change to a project. A noun.

object.kind.proposal.description: Small label on a card for something shared in a message: the item is a change, a built proposal to modify a project. A noun.

object.kind.governance.description: Small label on a card for something shared in a message: the item is a proposal to change a project's rules. A noun.

object.kind.spec.description: Small label on a card for something shared in a message: the item is one version of a change's plan, the written description of what the change will do.

object.kind.hub.description: Small label on a card for a link shared in a message: the link leads to a community's hub page.

object.kind.discussion.description: Small label on a card for a link shared in a message: the link leads to a project's discussion channel. A noun.

object.kind.unknown.description: Stands in for the kind of thing staged in the message box to be shared when its kind is not recognised. A noun.

object.requestNumber.description: Small label on a card for a request shared in a message. "Request" is a noun; {{number}} is the request number, keep the #.

object.unavailable.title.description: Title of the card shown in place of a shared item the reader has no access to.

object.unavailable.detail.description: Second line of the card shown in place of a shared item the reader has no access to.

object.untitled.description: Title on a card for a shared item that has no title of its own.

object.byAuthor.description: One fact in the dot-separated detail line of a card for a shared item, complete on its own: who created the item. It is joined to the other facts (the project, the item's status) by a middle dot. {{author}} is a username.

inbox.filter.all.description: Filter chip above the conversation list in Messages: shows every conversation.

inbox.filter.people.description: Filter chip above the conversation list in Messages: shows only conversations with people.

inbox.filter.agents.description: Filter chip above the conversation list in Messages: shows only conversations with AI agents.

channel.backCommunities.description: Label of the back control on the #general channel when it leads to the Communities screen.

thread.jumpToLatest.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the round arrow button over a conversation: scrolls down to the newest message.

thread.jumpToLatestNew_one.description: Accessible name of the round arrow button over a conversation when messages arrived while the reader was scrolled up. {{count}} is how many arrived.

thread.jumpToLatestNew_other.description: Accessible name of the round arrow button over a conversation when messages arrived while the reader was scrolled up. {{count}} is how many arrived.

thread.newMessages_one.description: Banner at the top of a conversation opened with unread messages: pressing it jumps to the first unread one. {{count}} is how many are unread.

thread.newMessages_other.description: Banner at the top of a conversation opened with unread messages: pressing it jumps to the first unread one. {{count}} is how many are unread.

refCard.open.description: Title of the card under a message that mentions a request by number, when the request's own title could not be loaded. "Open" is a verb.

store.you.description: Stands in for the signed-in person's username on a message they just sent, when the username is not known.

store.error.awaitingAcceptance.text: They need to accept your message request before you can send more.
store.error.awaitingAcceptance.description: Error in a conversation when a second message was sent before the other person accepted the first one (the message request).

store.error.gone.text: This conversation is no longer available.
store.error.gone.description: Error shown in place of a conversation that was deleted or that the person can no longer see.

store.error.tooFast.text: You’re doing that too quickly. Try again in a moment.
store.error.tooFast.description: Error in Messages when the server refused an action because too many were made in a short time.

store.error.loadList.description: Error in place of the conversation list in Messages when it could not be fetched.

store.error.loadThread.description: Error in place of a conversation's messages when they could not be fetched.

store.error.loadNewer.description: Error in a conversation when fetching the next, newer page of messages failed.

store.error.loadOlder.description: Error in a conversation when fetching the previous, older page of messages failed.

store.error.discussion.text: This discussion could not be opened.
store.error.discussion.description: Error in Messages when a project's discussion channel could not be opened.

store.error.queued.text: Message queued. It will retry when you reconnect.
store.error.queued.description: Notice in a conversation when a message was written while offline: it is kept and sent when the connection returns.

store.error.send.description: Error in a conversation when sending a message failed and the server gave no reason.

store.error.sendReply.description: Error in a thread when sending a reply failed and the server gave no reason.

store.error.loadReplies.description: Error in place of a thread's replies when they could not be fetched.

store.error.loadEarlierReplies.description: Error in a thread when fetching the earlier page of replies failed.

store.header.channel.description: Title in the app header while a project's channel is open and its name is not known yet. A noun.

store.header.thread.description: Title in the app header on a phone while a thread of replies is open. A noun.

store.header.discussion.description: Title in the app header while a project's discussion is open in Messages and its name is not known yet. A noun.

store.header.messages.description: Title in the app header on the Messages screen, and for a conversation that has no title.

store.askForChangesPlaceholder.description: Placeholder in the message box of the chat with Homeroom bot after pressing "Ask for changes" on a change, or "Tell Homeroom bot what to change" on a project's Hub: the person types what they want changed. "Change" is a verb.

api.deletedUser.description: Stands in for the author's username on a quoted message whose author's account no longer exists.

api.unknownUser.description: Stands where a username would be, for an account whose username did not come from the server. Shown alone, sometimes after an @. Lower case; keep it one short word.

store.error.groupNeedsName.description: Brief message shown when a person renames a group chat and leaves the name empty.

store.error.groupNameTooLong.text: Group names can be up to 80 characters.
store.error.groupNameTooLong.description: Brief message shown when a person renames a group chat with a name longer than 80 characters.

store.error.chooseConversation.description: Error line in the "Share to…" dialog when what was picked is not a conversation that can be shared to.

api.conversationTitle.description: Title of a conversation that has no name and whose other member is not known. A noun.

api.requestFailed.description: Error in Messages when a request to the server failed and the server gave no explanation. "Request" is a noun, the network request. {{status}} is the HTTP status number.

api.uploadFailed.description: Error under the message box when uploading an attachment failed and the server gave no explanation. {{status}} is the HTTP status number.

api.untitledItem.description: Title of a request or change in the "Share item" list when it has no title of its own.

api.approve.unreachable.description: Error on Homeroom bot's "ready to try" card when approving the change failed because the server could not be reached. Homeroom is the product's name.

api.approve.failed.description: Error on Homeroom bot's "ready to try" card when approving the change failed and the server gave no reason.

create.error.direct.description: Error in the "New message" dialog when starting a direct conversation failed and the server gave no reason.

create.error.group.description: Error in the "New message" dialog when creating a group chat failed and the server gave no reason.

create.error.unblock.description: Error in the "New message" dialog when unblocking a person failed and the server gave no reason.

create.error.block.description: Error in the "New message" dialog when blocking a person failed and the server gave no reason.

create.block.title.description: Title of the confirmation before blocking a person, so they can no longer message you. "Block" is a verb. {{username}} is that person; keep the @.

create.block.titleUnknown.description: Title of the confirmation before blocking a person, so they can no longer message you. "Block" is a verb. Used when the username is not known; "@unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

create.block.message.text: Their messages in shared chats and app discussions will be hidden, and they won’t be able to message you directly.
create.block.message.description: Body of the confirmation before blocking a person: what blocking does.

create.block.confirm.description: Confirm button of the confirmation before blocking a person. A verb: stop this person from messaging you.

create.title.description: Title of the dialog for starting a conversation with a person or creating a group chat.

create.typeTabs.description: Accessible name of the two tabs in the "New message" dialog that choose between a direct conversation and a group.

create.tab.direct.description: Tab in the "New message" dialog: start a one-to-one conversation. Short for "direct message".

create.tab.group.description: Tab in the "New message" dialog: create a group chat. A noun.

create.groupName.description: Label of the field for the new group chat's name in the "New message" dialog.

create.groupNamePlaceholder.description: Example of a group chat name, shown as the placeholder of the "Group name" field.

create.selectedMembers.description: Accessible name of the row of people chosen so far for a new group chat.

create.findPerson.description: Label of the search field in the "New message" dialog when starting a direct conversation.

create.invitePeople.description: Label of the search field in the "New message" dialog when creating a group chat.

create.searchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the people search field in the "New message" dialog.

create.result.add.description: Action shown on a person in the search results while creating a group chat: pressing the row adds them to the group.

create.result.message.description: Action shown on a person in the search results of the "New message" dialog: pressing the row opens a direct conversation with them. A verb.

create.result.blockNamed.description: Accessible name of the "Block" button beside a person in the search results. "Block" is a verb: stop this person from messaging you. {{username}} is that person; keep the @.

create.result.blockUnknown.description: Accessible name of the "Block" button beside a person in the search results. "Block" is a verb: stop this person from messaging you. Used when the username is not known; "@unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

create.result.block.description: Button beside a person in the search results of the "New message" dialog. A verb: stop this person from messaging you.

create.blockedPeople.description: Link at the foot of the "New message" dialog that shows the list of people you have blocked, and the heading of that list.

create.creating.description: Label of the "Create group" button while the group chat is being created.

create.createGroup.description: Button in the "New message" dialog: creates the group chat with the chosen name and people.

create.nobodyBlocked.description: Shown in the "Blocked people" list when you have not blocked anyone.

create.unblock.description: Button beside a person in the "Blocked people" list: lets them message you again.

create.searching.description: Shown under the people search field in the "New message" dialog while results load.

create.noMatches.description: Shown under the people search field in the "New message" dialog when nobody matches what was typed.

members.error.invite.description: Error in the "Group members" dialog when inviting people failed and the server gave no reason.

members.error.remove.description: Error in the "Group members" dialog when removing someone failed and the server gave no reason.

members.error.leave.description: Error in the "Group members" dialog when leaving the group failed and the server gave no reason.

members.remove.title.description: Title of the confirmation before removing a person from a group chat. {{username}} is that person; keep the @.

members.remove.titleUnknown.description: Title of the confirmation before removing a person from a group chat. Used when the username is not known; "@unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

members.remove.confirm.description: Confirm button of the confirmation before removing a person from a group chat.

members.leave.transfer.text: Ownership will transfer to the oldest remaining member.
members.leave.transfer.description: Body of the confirmation shown to a group chat's owner before they leave it: the member who joined earliest becomes the owner.

members.leave.title.description: Title of the confirmation before leaving a group chat. "Leave" is a verb: stop being a member. {{group}} is the group chat's name.

members.leave.titleUntitled.description: Title of the confirmation before leaving a group chat. "Leave" is a verb: stop being a member. Used for a conversation that has no name and whose other member is not known; "Conversation" is written as the title has always shown it.

members.leave.titleUnnamed.description: Title of the confirmation before leaving a group chat that has no name. "Leave" is a verb: stop being a member.

members.leave.confirm.description: Confirm button of the confirmation before leaving a group chat. A verb: stop being a member.

members.title.description: Title of the dialog that lists the people in a group chat.

members.subtitle.text: Accepted members can read the complete retained history.
members.subtitle.description: Line under the "Group members" title: people who accepted their invitation can read all messages the group still keeps, including older ones.

members.role.owner.description: Role shown under a person's name in the "Group members" list: the person who owns the group chat. Written in lower case; the screen capitalises it.

members.role.member.description: Role shown under a person's name in the "Group members" list: an ordinary member of the group chat. Written in lower case; the screen capitalises it.
