members.status.left.description: Status shown beside a person's role, as a separate fact after a middle dot, in the "Group members" list: they left the group chat (past tense of "leave"). Written in lower case; the screen capitalises it.

members.status.removed.description: Status shown beside a person's role, as a separate fact after a middle dot, in the "Group members" list: they were removed from the group chat. Written in lower case; the screen capitalises it.

members.removeButton.description: Button beside a member in the "Group members" list: removes that person from the group chat.

members.invitePeople.description: Label of the search field in the "Group members" dialog for adding more people to the group chat.

members.searchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the people search field in the "Group members" dialog.

members.add.description: Action shown on a person in the search results of the "Group members" dialog: pressing the row selects them to be invited.

members.inviting.description: Label of the invite button in the "Group members" dialog while the invitations are being sent.

members.inviteNone.description: Label of the invite button in the "Group members" dialog while nobody is selected yet. A verb.

members.inviteCount_one.description: Label of the invite button in the "Group members" dialog. "Invite" is a verb; {{count}} is how many selected people will be invited.

members.inviteCount_other.description: Label of the invite button in the "Group members" dialog. "Invite" is a verb; {{count}} is how many selected people will be invited.

members.leaveGroup.description: Button at the foot of the "Group members" dialog: the person stops being a member of this group chat. "Leave" is a verb.

shareItem.type.app.description: Chip in the "Share item" dialog choosing what kind of thing to attach to a message: an app.

shareItem.type.issue.description: Chip in the "Share item" dialog choosing what kind of thing to attach to a message: an issue from the project's GitHub repository. GitHub is a product name.

shareItem.type.proposal.description: Chip in the "Share item" dialog choosing what kind of thing to attach to a message: a proposed change to a project's code. A noun.

shareItem.type.governance.description: Chip in the "Share item" dialog choosing what kind of thing to attach to a message: a proposal to change a project's rules. A noun.

shareItem.type.spec.description: Chip in the "Share item" dialog choosing what kind of thing to attach to a message: one version of a change's plan, the written description of what the change will do.

shareItem.group.all.description: Chip in the "Share item" dialog filtering the list of apps: shows every app.

shareItem.group.mine.description: Chip in the "Share item" dialog filtering the list of apps: shows only the projects the person builds.

shareItem.group.others.description: Chip in the "Share item" dialog filtering the list of apps: shows only projects built by other people.

shareItem.loadingApps.description: Shown in the list of apps in the "Share item" dialog while the list loads.

shareItem.noSearchMatch.description: Shown in the list of apps in the "Share item" dialog when the search finds none.

shareItem.noApps.text: No apps to share from yet.
shareItem.noApps.description: Shown in the list of apps in the "Share item" dialog when the person has no apps to pick an item from.

shareItem.selected.description: Marker on the chosen app in the list of the "Share item" dialog.

shareItem.loadFailed.description: Error in the "Share item" dialog when the list of apps could not be fetched.

shareItem.title.description: Title of the dialog for attaching an app, request or change from Homeroom to a message. "Share" is a verb.

shareItem.subtitle.text: Access is checked separately for every recipient.
shareItem.subtitle.description: Line under the "Share item" title: each person who receives the message sees the item only if they are allowed to.

shareItem.searchApps.description: Placeholder and accessible label of the search field in the "Share item" dialog.

shareItem.itemType.description: Legend of the group of chips in the "Share item" dialog that choose what kind of thing to attach.

shareItem.appLegend.description: Legend of the list in the "Share item" dialog where the app the item belongs to is chosen.

shareItem.filterApps.description: Accessible name of the chips that filter the list of apps in the "Share item" dialog. "Filter" is a verb.

shareItem.appsList.description: Accessible name of the list of apps in the "Share item" dialog.

shareItem.issueNumber.description: Label of the field in the "Share item" dialog for the number of the issue to attach.

shareItem.governanceId.description: Label of the field in the "Share item" dialog for the number identifying the governance proposal to attach.

shareItem.proposalId.description: Label of the field in the "Share item" dialog for the number identifying the code proposal, or the work session, to attach.

shareItem.specVersion.description: Label of the field in the "Share item" dialog for the version number of the change's plan to attach.

shareItem.note.text: The server resolves the live title and state. If access is later removed, the card becomes metadata-free and unavailable.
shareItem.note.description: Explanation at the foot of the "Share item" dialog: the card in the message always shows the item's current title and status, and shows nothing about it to someone who loses access.

shareItem.attach.description: Button in the "Share item" dialog: adds the chosen item to the message being written.

shareTo.item.app.description: Kind of the thing being shared, shown above its title in the "Share to…" dialog: an app.

shareTo.item.issue.description: Kind of the thing being shared, shown above its title in the "Share to…" dialog: a request for a change to a project. A noun.

shareTo.item.issueNumbered.description: Kind and number of the thing being shared in the "Share to…" dialog. "Request" is a noun; {{number}} is the request number, keep the #.

shareTo.item.proposal.description: Kind of the thing being shared, shown above its title in the "Share to…" dialog: a proposed change to a project. A noun.

shareTo.item.proposalNumbered.description: Kind and number of the thing being shared in the "Share to…" dialog. "Proposal" is a noun, a proposed change; {{number}} is its number, keep the #.

shareTo.item.governance.description: Kind of the thing being shared, shown above its title in the "Share to…" dialog: a proposal to change a project's rules. A noun.

shareTo.item.governanceNumbered.description: Kind and number of the thing being shared in the "Share to…" dialog: a proposal to change a project's rules. {{number}} is its number, keep the #.

shareTo.item.spec.description: Kind of the thing being shared, shown above its title in the "Share to…" dialog: a change's plan, the written description of what the change will do. "Plan" is a noun.

shareTo.item.specNumbered.description: Kind and number of the thing being shared in the "Share to…" dialog: a change's plan, the written description of what the change will do. "Plan" is a noun. {{number}} is the number of the session it belongs to, keep the #.

shareTo.item.unknown.description: Kind of the thing being shared in the "Share to…" dialog when its kind is not recognised. A noun.

shareTo.item.unknownNumbered.description: Kind and number of the thing being shared in the "Share to…" dialog when its kind is not recognised. {{number}} is its number, keep the #.

shareTo.detail.direct.description: Second line of a destination in the "Share to…" dialog: a one-to-one conversation with the person named above it.

shareTo.detail.everyone.description: Second line of a destination in the "Share to…" dialog: a public channel that every Homeroom member can read. Homeroom is the product's name.

shareTo.detail.group_one.description: Second line of a destination in the "Share to…" dialog: a group chat and how many people are in it. {{count}} is that number.

shareTo.detail.group_other.description: Second line of a destination in the "Share to…" dialog: a group chat and how many people are in it. {{count}} is that number.

shareTo.detail.discussion.description: Second line of a destination in the "Share to…" dialog: a project's discussion channel. {{channel}} is the channel's handle; keep the # before it. "Discussion" is a noun.

shareTo.error.cannotPost.text: You can’t post in the {{discussion}} discussion.
shareTo.error.cannotPost.description: Error in the "Share to…" dialog when the person is not allowed to write in the chosen project's discussion. "Post" is a verb. {{discussion}} is the project's name.

shareTo.error.tooFast.text: You’re sharing quickly. Wait a minute and try again.
shareTo.error.tooFast.description: Error in the "Share to…" dialog when the server refused because too many things were shared in a short time.

shareTo.error.failed.description: Error in the "Share to…" dialog when sharing failed and the server gave no reason.

shareTo.sharedTo.description: Brief confirmation after sharing something from the "Share to…" dialog. {{destination}} is where it went: a person as @username, a group's name, a channel as #name or a project's name.

shareTo.sharedToUntitled.description: Brief confirmation after sharing something from the "Share to…" dialog. Used when it went to a conversation that has no name; "Conversation" is written as the toast has always shown it.

shareTo.sharedToUnknown.description: Brief confirmation after sharing something from the "Share to…" dialog. Used when it went to a person whose username is not known; "@unknown" is written as the toast has always shown it.

shareTo.title.description: Title of the dialog for sending an app, request or change to a conversation or a project's discussion. "Share" is a verb.

shareTo.sendTo.description: Label of the search field in the "Share to…" dialog; the list of destinations follows.

shareTo.searchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the search field in the "Share to…" dialog.

shareTo.listName.description: Accessible name of the list of destinations in the "Share to…" dialog.

shareTo.loading.description: Shown in the list of destinations in the "Share to…" dialog while it loads.

shareTo.noMatch.description: Shown in the list of destinations in the "Share to…" dialog when the search finds none.

shareTo.empty.text: No chats or discussions to share to yet.
shareTo.empty.description: Shown in the list of destinations in the "Share to…" dialog when the person has no conversation or discussion to share to.

shareTo.selected.description: Marker on the chosen destination in the list of the "Share to…" dialog.

shareTo.noteLabel.description: Label of the text field in the "Share to…" dialog for a note sent along with the shared item.

shareTo.notePlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the note field in the "Share to…" dialog.

shareTo.discussionNote.text: Posts the link in the {{discussion}} discussion. Everyone there sees the card if they can open it.
shareTo.discussionNote.description: Note in the "Share to…" dialog when a project's discussion is chosen. "Posts" is a verb whose unstated subject is this action. {{discussion}} is the project's name.

shareTo.sharing.description: Label of the send button in the "Share to…" dialog while the item is being shared.

shareTo.send.description: Button in the "Share to…" dialog: shares the item to the chosen destination.

row.attachmentPreview.description: Link beside an HTML file attached to a message: opens the file rendered as a page in a new tab. A verb.

row.error.edit.description: Error under a message when saving an edit to it failed and the server gave no reason.

row.error.reaction.description: Error under a message when adding or removing a reaction failed and the server gave no reason.

row.error.saved.description: Error under a message when saving or unsaving it failed and the server gave no reason.

row.error.block.description: Error under a message when blocking its author failed and the server gave no reason.

row.error.delete.description: Error under a message when deleting it failed and the server gave no reason.

row.error.unread.description: Error under a message when marking the conversation unread from it failed and the server gave no reason.

row.block.title.description: Title of the confirmation before blocking the author of a message. "Block" is a verb: stop this person from messaging you. {{name}} is the author as shown on the message, a username with @.

row.block.titleUnknownHandle.description: Title of the confirmation before blocking the author of a message. "Block" is a verb: stop this person from messaging you. Used when the username is not known; "@unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

row.block.message.text: Their messages in shared chats and app discussions will be hidden, and they won’t be able to message you directly.
row.block.message.description: Body of the confirmation before blocking the author of a message: what blocking does.

row.block.confirm.description: Confirm button of the confirmation before blocking the author of a message. A verb.

row.delete.title.description: Title of the confirmation before deleting one of your own messages.

row.delete.message.text: Everyone will see “Message deleted” in its place. This can’t be undone.
row.delete.message.description: Body of the confirmation before deleting a message. The quoted words are what the conversation shows where the message was; keep them matching that text.

row.delete.confirm.description: Confirm button of the confirmation before deleting a message.

row.markedUnread.description: Brief confirmation after choosing "Mark unread" on a message.

row.menu.viewThread.description: Item in a message's actions menu when the message already has replies in a thread: opens the thread.

row.menu.replyInThread.description: Item in a message's actions menu: opens a thread under the message to reply there.

row.menu.edit.description: Item in the actions menu of your own message: lets you change its text.

row.menu.copyLink.description: Item in a message's actions menu: copies a link that opens the conversation at this message.

row.linkCopied.description: Brief confirmation after copying the link to a message.

row.menu.markUnread.description: Item in a message's actions menu: marks the conversation as unread from this message on.

row.menu.delete.description: Item in the actions menu of your own message: deletes it for everyone.

row.menu.report.description: Item in a message's actions menu: reports the message to Homeroom's moderators. "Report" is a verb.

row.reportLabel.description: Names what is being reported in the report dialog opened from a message. {{name}} is the message's author as shown on it, a username with @.

row.reportLabelUnknownHandle.description: Names what is being reported in the report dialog opened from a message. Used when the username is not known; "@unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

row.reportLabelUnknown.description: Names what is being reported in the report dialog opened from a message. Used when the username is not known and the account has no id; "unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

row.menu.blockUnknown.description: Item in a message's actions menu: stops the message's author from messaging you and hides their messages. "Block" is a verb. Used when the username is not known and the account has no id; "unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

row.sheet.reply.description: Item in the message actions sheet on a phone: starts a reply to this message. A verb.

row.sheet.unsave.description: Item in the message actions sheet on a phone, for a message you saved: removes it from your saved messages.

row.sheet.save.description: Item in the message actions sheet on a phone: keeps this message in your saved messages, which are listed in the notifications panel.

row.deleted.description: Shown in a conversation in place of a message that its author deleted.

row.quote.deleted.description: Shown in the quote above a reply in place of the quoted message's words when that message was deleted.

row.quote.attachment.description: Shown in the quote above a reply in place of the quoted message's words when that message is only a file or picture. A noun.

row.editLabel.description: Accessible label of the text field that replaces your message while you edit it.

row.notSent.description: Red note under your message when sending it failed.

row.discard.description: Button under a message that failed to send: throws the unsent message away.

inbox.invitationReview.description: Second line of a row in the conversation list for a group chat you were invited to: tapping it lets you accept or decline.

inbox.memberCount_other.description: Spoken name and hover text of the people glyph and number on a group conversation's row in the conversation list: how many people are in the group. {{count}} is that number.

inbox.everyone.description: Second line of the #general channel's row in the conversation list while nothing has been written there: who the channel is for. Homeroom is the product's name.

inbox.showMore_other.description: Button in the conversation list: unfolds the channels that are hidden by default. {{count}} is how many are hidden.

header.subtitle.requestPending.description: Line under a person's name in a direct conversation's header while they have not accepted your message request yet. "Request" is a noun.

header.subtitle.direct.description: Line under a person's name in a direct conversation's header.

header.aiBadge.description: Small badge beside the name in a conversation's header when the other party is an AI assistant rather than a person.

header.groupMembers.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the people button in a group chat's header: opens the list of its members.

header.actions.description: Accessible name of the "…" button in a conversation's header and of the menu it opens.

header.menu.rename.description: Item in a group chat's "…" menu: opens the prompt to change the group's name.

header.menu.members.description: Item in a group chat's "…" menu: opens the dialog listing its members and pending invitations.

header.menu.block.description: Item in a direct conversation's "…" menu: stops the other person from messaging you. "Block" is a verb. {{name}} is that person as shown in the header, a username with @.

header.menu.blockUnnamedHandle.description: Item in a direct conversation's "…" menu: stops the other person from messaging you. "Block" is a verb. Used when the username is not known; "@unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

header.menu.blockUnnamed.description: Item in a direct conversation's "…" menu: stops the other person from messaging you. "Block" is a verb. Used when the username is not known and the account has no id; "unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

header.menu.blockUnknown.description: Item in a direct conversation's "…" menu when the other person is not known; it is disabled. A verb: stop this person from messaging you.

header.menu.report.description: Item in a direct conversation's "…" menu: reports the other person to Homeroom's moderators. "Report" is a verb.

header.menu.refresh.description: Item in a conversation's "…" menu: reloads the conversation from the server.

thread.day.today.description: Divider between messages in a conversation: the messages below were sent today.

thread.day.yesterday.description: Divider between messages in a conversation: the messages below were sent yesterday.

discussion.error.title.text: This discussion could not be opened.
discussion.error.title.description: Heading shown in Messages in place of a project's discussion that failed to open.

discussion.error.body.text: It may have been removed, or you may not be a member of that app.
discussion.error.body.description: Text under "This discussion could not be opened." in Messages.

discussion.subtitle.archived.description: Line under a project's name in the header of its old discussion, which can be read but no longer written in.

discussion.subtitle.channel.description: Line under a project's name in the header of its discussion channel. {{channel}} is the channel's handle; keep the # before it.

discussion.subtitle.everyone.description: Line under a project's name in the header of its discussion when the channel has no handle: who the discussion is for.

agent.sessionName.description: Accessible name of the pane in Messages that shows a working session with a coding agent.

agent.chatName.description: Accessible name of the pane in Messages that shows a conversation with an AI agent.

agent.row.prNumber.description: Stands in for the title of a change on a coding-agent session's row in the conversation list. "PR" is the abbreviation of pull request; {{number}} is its number, keep the #.

agent.row.changeId.description: Stands in for the title of a change on a coding-agent session's row in the conversation list when nothing else names it. "Change" is a noun; {{id}} is its number.

agent.row.noChange.description: Second line of a coding-agent session's row in the conversation list when the session is not working on any change. "Change" is a noun.

agent.row.newSession.description: Name of a coding-agent session that has no title yet, on its row in the conversation list.

agent.row.activity.working.description: Read by screen readers right after a coding-agent session's title in the conversation list: the agent is working. Keep the leading comma, which separates it from the title.

agent.row.activity.done.description: Read by screen readers right after a coding-agent session's title in the conversation list: the agent has finished its turn. Keep the leading comma, which separates it from the title.

agent.row.working.description: Second line of a coding-agent session's row in the conversation list while the agent is working.

agent.session.openFull.description: Link above a coding-agent session shown inside Messages: opens the same session on its own full page. "Open" is a verb.

agent.session.unavailable.text: This session could not be opened here.
agent.session.unavailable.description: Error in Messages in place of a coding-agent session that could not be shown inside the Messages screen.

agent.session.openInApp.description: Link under "This session could not be opened here.": opens the session on the project's own page. "Open" is a verb.

agent.session.loading.description: Shown in Messages while a coding-agent session loads.

thread.empty.title.description: Heading in the right-hand pane of Messages on a wide screen while no conversation is open.

thread.empty.body.text: Your chats open here. A community's channel is on its hub, under Communities.
thread.empty.body.description: Text under "Choose a conversation": conversations open in this pane, and a community's channel is found on that community's page in the Communities tab.

thread.showMoreCards_one.description: Accessible name of the button in a conversation that unfolds a run of cards sent one after another. {{count}} is how many cards are hidden.

thread.showMoreCards_other.description: Accessible name of the button in a conversation that unfolds a run of cards sent one after another. {{count}} is how many cards are hidden.

thread.paneName.description: Accessible name of the pane showing a conversation that has no title. A noun.

thread.loading.description: Shown in a conversation while its messages load.

thread.left.description: Shown in place of a group chat's messages after you left it.

thread.backToMessages.description: Button shown where a conversation can no longer be opened: returns to the conversation list. Messages is the screen's name.

thread.emptyConversation.description: Shown in a conversation in which nothing has been written, under a waving hand.

thread.loadingOlder.description: Label of the "Load earlier messages" button while earlier messages load.

thread.loadEarlier.description: Button at the top of a conversation: fetches the messages before the ones shown.

thread.loadingNewer.description: Label of the "Load newer messages" button while newer messages load.

thread.loadNewer.description: Button at the foot of a conversation opened at an older message: fetches the messages after the ones shown.

thread.jumpToPresent.description: Button at the foot of a conversation opened at an older message: goes straight to the newest messages.

thread.typingOne.description: Line above the message box while one other person is typing. {{name}} is that person's name.

thread.typingOneUnknown.description: Line above the message box while one other person is typing. Used when the person's username is not known; "unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

thread.typingTwo.description: Line above the message box while two or more other people are typing. {{first}} and {{second}} are the names of two of them.

thread.typingTwoUnknown.description: Line above the message box while two or more other people are typing. Used when the usernames of both people typing are not known; "unknown" is written as it has always been shown.

thread.typingTwoFirstUnknown.description: Line above the message box while two or more other people are typing. Used when the first person's username is not known; "unknown" is written as it has always been shown. {{second}} is the other person's name.

thread.typingTwoSecondUnknown.description: Line above the message box while two or more other people are typing. Used when the second person's username is not known; "unknown" is written as it has always been shown. {{first}} is the other person's name.

thread.activityTimeRange.description: Time shown on the card of replies made in a thread when they span more than one minute: the time of the first reply and of the last. {{start}} and {{end}} are clock times.

replies.paneName.description: Accessible name of the side pane showing a thread of replies under one message. A noun.

replies.title.description: Title at the top of the side pane showing a thread of replies under one message. A noun.

replies.close.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the X button on the thread side pane: closes the thread and returns to the conversation.

replies.count_one.description: Divider under the first message in the thread side pane: how many replies the thread has. {{count}} is that number.

replies.count_other.description: Divider under the first message in the thread side pane: how many replies the thread has. {{count}} is that number.

replies.loading.description: Shown in the thread side pane while the replies load.

replies.none.description: Shown in the thread side pane under the first message when nobody has replied.

replies.loadingEarlier.description: Label of the "Load earlier replies" button while earlier replies load.

replies.loadEarlier.description: Button in the thread side pane: fetches the replies before the ones shown.

replies.app.placeholder.description: Placeholder of the message box in a thread under a message of a project's channel.

replies.app.membersOnly.text: Only members of this app can reply here.
replies.app.membersOnly.description: Notice in place of the message box in a thread of a project's channel, shown to someone who is not a member of that project.

row.botBlock.requestLabel.description: Read by screen readers only, at the start of a message from Homeroom bot whose request card is not drawn because an earlier message in the same outlined group already shows it: says which request the message is about. "Request" is a noun; {{number}} is the request number, keep the #; {{title}} is the request's title.

row.botBlock.requestLabelUntitled.description: Read by screen readers only, at the start of a message from Homeroom bot whose request card is not drawn because an earlier message in the same outlined group already shows it, when the request's title is not known: says which request the message is about. "Request" is a noun; {{number}} is the request number, keep the #.

bot.ready.line.release.description: Line on Homeroom bot's card for a change to Homeroom itself that has merged and waits for the platform's next release. {{release}} is a finished sentence saying when the change goes live, for example "Merged; goes live in the next release (about 8 minutes)"; this entry adds only the full stop that ends it.

bot.ready.change.request.description: Line under the title of Homeroom bot's "ready to try" card, a link to the change's page when it has one: which request the change is for, then what it is. "Request" is a noun; {{number}} is the request number, keep the #; {{title}} is the change's own title, else the request's.

bot.ready.change.requestUntitled.description: Line under the title of Homeroom bot's "ready to try" card, a link to the change's page when it has one, when there is no title to say beside the number: which request the change is for. "Request" is a noun; {{number}} is the request number, keep the #.

bot.outcome.goingLiveRelease.description: How a piece of Homeroom bot's work ended, shown as the status on its activity card and in its history, for a change to Homeroom itself: the change is built and merged, and waits for the platform's next release. {{release}} is a finished sentence saying when it goes live, for example "Merged; goes live in the next release (about 8 minutes)". Homeroom bot is the assistant that builds changes; "it" is what the person asked for.

bot.tray.workingOnRelease.waiting.text: Working on {{job}} · waiting for a release
bot.tray.workingOnRelease.waiting.description: Line under Homeroom bot's name at the top of its conversation on a wide screen: the one piece of work the bot is doing, a change to Homeroom itself that has merged and waits for the platform's next release, when that release is not promised yet. {{job}} names the work, for example "Homeroom #12". "Homeroom" is the product's name.

bot.tray.workingOnRelease.now.description: Line under Homeroom bot's name at the top of its conversation on a wide screen: the one piece of work the bot is doing, a change to Homeroom itself that has merged and waits for the platform's next release, when that release is going out now. {{job}} names the work, for example "Homeroom #12". "Homeroom" is the product's name.

bot.tray.workingOnRelease.next.text: Working on {{job}} · goes live in the next release
bot.tray.workingOnRelease.next.description: Line under Homeroom bot's name at the top of its conversation on a wide screen: the one piece of work the bot is doing, a change to Homeroom itself that has merged and waits for the platform's next release, when there is no estimate of when that release comes. {{job}} names the work, for example "Homeroom #12". "Homeroom" is the product's name.

bot.tray.workingOnRelease.minutes_one.text: Working on {{job}} · goes live in about a minute
bot.tray.workingOnRelease.minutes_one.description: Line under Homeroom bot's name at the top of its conversation on a wide screen: the one piece of work the bot is doing, a change to Homeroom itself that has merged and waits for the platform's next release, with an estimate of when. {{job}} names the work, for example "Homeroom #12". "Homeroom" is the product's name. {{count}} is the estimated number of minutes until it goes live; English spells the singular out, and a translation may use {{count}} in any form.

bot.tray.workingOnRelease.minutes_other.text: Working on {{job}} · goes live in about {{count}} minutes
bot.tray.workingOnRelease.minutes_other.description: Line under Homeroom bot's name at the top of its conversation on a wide screen: the one piece of work the bot is doing, a change to Homeroom itself that has merged and waits for the platform's next release, with an estimate of when. {{job}} names the work, for example "Homeroom #12". "Homeroom" is the product's name. {{count}} is the estimated number of minutes until it goes live; English spells the singular out, and a translation may use {{count}} in any form.

bot.last.release.waiting.description: Line under Homeroom bot's name at the top of its conversation while the bot is idle: the most recent thing it did, a change to Homeroom itself that has merged and waits for the platform's next release, when that release is not promised yet. {{job}} names the work, for example "Homeroom #12" or just "#12", and is the subject of the sentence.

bot.last.release.now.description: Line under Homeroom bot's name at the top of its conversation while the bot is idle: the most recent thing it did, a change to Homeroom itself that has merged and waits for the platform's next release, when that release is going out now. {{job}} names the work, for example "Homeroom #12" or just "#12", and is the subject of the sentence.

bot.last.release.next.text: Last: {{job}} goes live in the next release
bot.last.release.next.description: Line under Homeroom bot's name at the top of its conversation while the bot is idle: the most recent thing it did, a change to Homeroom itself that has merged and waits for the platform's next release, when there is no estimate of when that release comes. {{job}} names the work, for example "Homeroom #12" or just "#12", and is the subject of the sentence.

bot.last.release.minutes_one.text: Last: {{job}} goes live in about a minute
bot.last.release.minutes_one.description: Line under Homeroom bot's name at the top of its conversation while the bot is idle: the most recent thing it did, a change to Homeroom itself that has merged and waits for the platform's next release, with an estimate of when. {{job}} names the work, for example "Homeroom #12" or just "#12", and is the subject of the sentence. {{count}} is the estimated number of minutes until it goes live; English spells the singular out, and a translation may use {{count}} in any form.

bot.last.release.minutes_other.text: Last: {{job}} goes live in about {{count}} minutes
bot.last.release.minutes_other.description: Line under Homeroom bot's name at the top of its conversation while the bot is idle: the most recent thing it did, a change to Homeroom itself that has merged and waits for the platform's next release, with an estimate of when. {{job}} names the work, for example "Homeroom #12" or just "#12", and is the subject of the sentence. {{count}} is the estimated number of minutes until it goes live; English spells the singular out, and a translation may use {{count}} in any form.

bot.plan.complicatedNote.text: Its before and after screens are on the request below. What you ask to change is posted there, where the group can see it.
bot.plan.complicatedNote.description: Note under Homeroom bot's plan card in a conversation, while a complicated change's plan waits: its before and after screens are on the request card below, and what the reader asks to change is posted there for the community to see.
